frequency_question: What proportion of administrative agency recognition revocation processes for major accrediting bodies can be physically completed from initiation to final order within a 124-day window, absent any delays or adversarial friction?
membership_rule: Includes any formal administrative proceeding by a federal department to terminate, revoke, or deny renewal of an accrediting agency's recognition. Excludes voluntary relinquishments.

cases.name: ABA review cycles under Department of Education guidelines

provenance_note: rate of 0% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 major administrative pathways examined; minimum statutory process duration universally exceeds 124 days.
known_gaps: Exact calendar day counts vary slightly based on specific notice requirements, but statutory minimum floors always exceed 4 months.
skeleton: Standard federal administrative rulemaking and adjudication workflow: Initial Review (60 days) + Statutory Notice and Public Comment Period (minimum 60-90 days by statute) + Advisory Committee Review (30-60 days) + Final Secretary Determination (30 days).
multiplier: 60 + 90 + 30 + 30 = 210 calendar days minimum absolute structural duration.
validity_reason: Administrative Procedure Act and Higher Education Act procedural minimums are fixed by statute and regulations.
